best_for: MarketCallouts shows several markets served by one machine: a single PW package drawn with IsoKit stands centred on a navy ground as a solid limestone object, and each option is a callout around it with a leader to the part its note is about.

items.d: [hospital water scope]. CSA Z314:23; ANSI/AAMI ST108:2023. Critical water (ST108): looser on ions than PW, tighter on microbes, with an endotoxin limit.
items.note: Critical water (ST108): looser on ions than PW, tighter on microbes, with an endotoxin limit.

items.d: [lab water scope]. ASTM D1193-24: central reverse osmosis (RO), with electrodeionization (EDI) where needed; Type I from point-of-use polishers [whether Aquemi integrates third-party polishers].
items.note: Central reverse osmosis (RO), with electrodeionization (EDI) where needed; Type I from point-of-use polishers [whether Aquemi integrates third-party polishers].

items.d: [industrial water scope]. Limits from your process or equipment maker; RO and EDI replace regenerated ion exchange.
items.note: Limits from your process or equipment maker; RO and EDI replace regenerated ion exchange.
